watches.name: Celebi V 245/264 Fusion Strike Alt Art
watches._note: Pokemon (first non-One-Piece watch). Fusion Strike has NO regular Celebi V — 245/264 is the sole Celebi V in the set, so name+number uniquely identifies the alt art. Sig 1 = celebi v + full number (245264, incl. the common 245/265 typo). Sig 2 = celebi v + set + bare 245 + alt-art descriptor, guarding the collision-prone bare '245' (which substring-hits '245 cards' counts/certs). Excludes anchored ('cards lot' not bare 'lot', which would hit 'Holo Trading'->'holotrading'). Verified offline: 12/12 real titles matched, 12/12 confusables (Gengar VMAX 270/264, Genesect/Boltund 24x, bulk lots, sealed, jumbo, Japanese) rejected.
queries: celebi v 245/264 fusion strike alt art
pokemon celebi v fusion strike alternate full art
celebi v 245 fusion strike alt art teeziro
watches._exclude_note: sealed/bulk/lot terms (jumbo, booster box, ETB, cards lot, cards collection, ...) are now handled centrally by is_bulk_or_sealed(); only the card-specific 'vunion' (Celebi V-UNION) remains here.
watches._language_note: language 'any' (not 'english'): unlike One Piece (same number across languages), the English Pokemon alt-art number is unique to the English set — the Japanese print has a different number — so the number already gates language, and 'english' would wrongly DROP legit 'English NOT Japanese'-style titles.

watches.name: Giratina V Alt Art 186/196 (Lost Origin)
watches._note: Pokemon. Identify by number 186/196 (normalizes to '186196'): a contiguous substring unique to this card — the regular V is 130/196, and every Giratina VSTAR is 131/201/212. Require the bare name 'giratina' (NOT 'giratina v', whose norm 'giratinav' is a prefix of 'giratinavstar') + '186/196'; also exclude 'vstar' belt-and-suspenders. Excludes anchored ('cards lot' not bare 'lot', which would drop 'Holo TCG'->'holotcg'). Verified offline: 12/12 real titles matched, 14/14 confusables (regular V 130, VSTAR 131/201/212, Full Art 185/196, jumbo, master set/ETB/booster box, Japanese) rejected.
queries: giratina v alt art 186/196 lost origin
giratina v alternate full art 186/196 lost origin
watches._exclude_note: sealed/bulk/lot terms are now handled centrally by is_bulk_or_sealed(); only the card-specific 'vstar' (keeps out Giratina VSTAR) remains here.
watches._language_note: language 'any': the English 186/196 number is unique to the English set (Japanese alt art is 111/100), so the number gates language and 'english' would drop legit 'English not Japanese' titles.

watches.name: Mew ex 232/091 SIR (Paldean Fates)
watches._note: Pokemon. 232/091 is the Special Illustration Rare 'Bubble Mew'; the only sibling in the set is Mew ex 216/091 (Shiny UR), excluded by number (both 216/091 and 216/91 spellings). match_any also handles the common '232/91' leading-zero form (normalizes to '23291', distinct from '232091'), a bare '#232'+set+SIR path, and a numberless 'bubble mew'+set path. Require 'mew ex' not bare 'mew' (which substring-hits 'mewtwo', also excluded). Verified offline: 13/13 real titles matched, 13/13 confusables (216/091 both forms, Mewtwo, 151-set Mew ex 205/165 & 193/165, bulk/master-set/jumbo/sealed, Japanese 347/190) rejected.

watches.name: Mew ex 347/190 SAR (Shiny Treasure ex, JP)
watches._note: Pokemon, Japanese. The Japanese counterpart of the English 232/091 'Bubble Mew' — Shiny Treasure ex (sv4a) Mew ex 347/190 SAR (Special Art Rare). Identify by the full number 347/190 ('347190', unique to this card); a second match_any signature catches bare '#347' titles when paired with the set + SAR/bubble descriptor. Require 'mew ex' (not bare 'mew', which substring-hits 'mewtwo', also excluded). language 'any' because the Japanese-specific number already gates it and most listings are CJK/Japanese-tagged. Verified offline: 8/8 real titles matched (incl. CJK + graded), 8/8 confusables (Mewtwo, English 232/091, other set Mew ex, sealed/lot/bulk, extended-art case) rejected.
